verdict.rationale: Oyster's pricing page claims "Automated expenses, time-off, and reports" alongside multi-country payroll, so it does offer its own time-off capability. Nothing documents defining PTO policies, accrual rules, approval workflows, or time-off flowing automatically into payroll. Missing for 10: documented PTO policy configuration, accrual rules, time-off approval workflows, automatic payroll application of time-off, independent or hands-on corroboration.
